title: Where Nothing Is Afraid
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The wolf lies down beside the lamb
And no one is afraid;
The lion and the little calf
Rest in the quiet shade.

[Chorus]
Lie down, lie down, the world is kind,
The evening light is low;
A little child will lead us home
Where all the gentle go.

[Verse 2]
No one gets hurt, no one is mean,
No cross or hurried word;
The kindness Heavenly Father planned
Is all that will be heard.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
And I can bring a little piece
Of that sweet world tonight —
A gentle hand, a softer voice,
A room that feels like light.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my gentle one,
And let the darkness keep
The peace that Heavenly Father made
For little ones to sleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Lying-down music. A slow, settling pulse that loosens a little with every verse, like two animals that were never meant to be friends folding their legs under them in the same warm grass. A small string quartet and nothing else: inner voices moving by step, the cello finding the floor of each line and staying there. It travels downward and inward, ending lower and quieter than it began.
